# Coding Mantis Games

> Indie game studio from Kerala, India, creating co-op and shared-screen experiences designed to be played together.

Coding Mantis Games (OPC) Private Limited is an indie game studio based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India. The studio focuses on building co-op and shared-screen games that create fun, chaos, competition, and memorable moments for friends, couples, and families.

## Our Game

### Wheel You Drive?
- **Genre:** Co-op, Casual, Indie, Adventure
- **Platform:** PC (Steam)
- **Release:** Q1 2027
- **Players:** 2-player local co-op
- **Description:** A chaotic 2-player co-op RC car game where both players share control of the same RC car — but each controls a different half. Player 1 handles front wheel steering, backward movement, and front wheel jump. Player 2 handles back wheel steering, forward movement, and back wheel jump. Players must communicate and coordinate every move to navigate obstacles and complete levels together.
- **Steam:** https://store.steampowered.com/app/5245830/Wheel_You_Drive/
- **itch.io:** https://codingmantisgames.itch.io/
- **Awards:** IGDC 2026 Indie 60 Official Selection, IGDC 2026 Upcoming Game of the Year Nominee
